$comment: Shared MCP tools for every agent on this repo. github/context7 are REMOTE/http endpoints so the cloud Replit agent can reach them too (tokens come from env vars, never committed). github = the cross-agent coordination bus (issues/PRs/reviews); context7 = current library docs. Verified live 2026-07-09: POST https://api.githubcopilot.com/mcp/ initialize returns tools/prompts/resources. grepai is LOCAL-ONLY (stdio, spawns a binary on the machine) — it only works for agents running directly on Igor's Mac (e.g. this Claude Code CLI), NOT for the cloud Replit agent. It is a free/local semantic code-search index (Tree-sitter chunking + Ollama nomic-embed-text embeddings, zero cloud calls, zero ongoing cost) — see docs/LOCAL-SEMANTIC-CODE-INDEX.md for setup/rationale/limitations. Added 2026-07-24.

context7.$comment: Keyless mode on purpose: an unset CONTEXT7_API_KEY used to interpolate an EMPTY 'Bearer ' header, which the server rejects as an invalid key (verified live 2026-08-06). Keyless = low rate limits (fine for JIT doc lookups). If we mint a ctx7sk key (context7.com/dashboard, free tier 1000 req/mo), re-add headers.Authorization = 'Bearer <key from env>' AND actually set the env var everywhere agents run.

semrush.$comment: Semrush MCP (SEL 2026-08-12 data-tools pattern). Do NOT add Authorization: Bearer ${SEMRUSH_API_KEY:-} — empty expansion sends invalid 'Bearer ' (same class as context7 empty-header bug 2026-08-06). When SEMRUSH_API_KEY is set in the agent host env, re-add headers.Authorization = 'Bearer <key>' (prefer host secret injection, never commit the key).

gurobi.$comment: Real gurobipy MCP (size-limited free pip). AE Fabrizio 2026-08-12: free pip first, full trial later.
